statement.text: Is it true that if <math>M_1, \ldots, M_k</math> are [[wikipedia:matroid|matroids]] on the same ground set ''S'' and <math>\sum_{i=1}^k r_i (X_i) \geq (k-1)l</math> for all partitions <math>X_1, \ldots, X_k</math> of ''S'', then there exists a common independent set of size <math>l</math>?
